feed_summary: Overview While performing continuous red teaming exercises through Rapid7’s Vector Command service, Rapid7 discovered CVE-2026-108065 , an SQL Injection vulnerability (CWE-89) in Channel Software WebAlliance eCommerce.The exploit allows a malicious actor to read sensitive data from the database, or, if the database user has high privileges, run system commands on the database server. The vulnerability, scored as CVSSv3.1 9.8 (Critical). Product Description WebAlliance eCommerce by Channel Software is an all-in-one B2B e-commerce, digital catalog, and customer portal platform purpose-built for wholesale distributors and industrial manufacturers.
